_doc: LOCAL TEST inventory: one pretend machine with two ledger-host nodes joining the phase-0 drill cluster (k1p0_a1net, beacons = the three running mother nodes). No mother nodes here on purpose: they already run. Use with: compose -inventory hosts/inventory.local.json -external-network k1p0_a1net -ip-prefix 172.31.0 -ip-base 100 -beacons <NodeID>@172.31.0.11:9651,...
